cases.situation: I've been fighting a flaky Cypress test for two hours and Jonas wrote most of that test suite. We're peers, he's busy with the release too. How do I ask him without sounding helpless?
cases.reply: Hey Jonas, the checkout Cypress test is failing about one run in three and I've spent two hours on it. I've ruled out the test data and the retry config, and it only fails in CI, not locally. Could you pair with me for 15 minutes this afternoon? If you're buried in the release, tomorrow morning works too.
cases.note: Showing the two things already ruled out turns 'help me' into 'help me finish', and 15 minutes is easy to say yes to.

cases.situation: 我是组长，想把下个月客户年会的物料统筹交给新来的同事小周，她之前在上一家公司做过活动。怎么说才不像甩锅？
cases.reply: 小周，想请你来负责11月18号客户年会的全部物料统筹。你之前做过好几场活动，这块你比组里其他人都熟。完成的标准是：11月8号前把展架、手册和伴手礼都定稿下单，预算控制在3万以内。初稿出来我随时帮你过一遍，我也会跟王经理说好，这件事正式算在你的工作量里。你看现在手上的事情，接得下来吗？
cases.note: 说清结果、为什么是她、完成标准和截止日，最后真心问一句她接不接得住，而不是直接派活。

cases.situation: In a meeting with the VP today she asked me what our churn rate was for enterprise accounts last quarter and I blanked. I want to send a follow-up on Slack.
cases.reply: Hi Carla, on your question about enterprise churn in Q2: I didn't have the number in my head and didn't want to guess. I'm pulling it from the billing data with Ahmed now and will send you the exact figure, with the three biggest accounts we lost, by 4pm today. Is this for the board deck, or something else I should shape it for?
cases.note: The 'I don't know' formula: say it cleanly, name the next step and a time, and ask what the answer feeds into.

cases.situation: I'm a marketing manager and need someone from legal to review the rules for our October giveaway before it goes live on Monday Oct 12. Nobody in legal reports to me and I've never worked with them. The legal ops contact is Grace Liu.
cases.reply: Hi Grace, I'm running the Harvest giveaway for marketing, launching Monday 12 October, and we need a legal review of the official rules before it goes live. It's a two-page doc adapted from the spring giveaway your team approved in April, and I've highlighted the three sections that changed. Could someone on your team review it by end of day Wednesday 7 October? If that's too tight with your current queue, tell me what date works and I'll plan the launch around it.
cases.note: Cross-team you have no authority, so make the job small, say exactly what done looks like, and let them name the date if yours doesn't fit.

cases.situation: I asked my peer Ravi on the data team to build the churn dashboard for our QBR by Friday Oct 9. He replied that there's no way, he's on the migration until the 16th. I still need something for the QBR on Monday Oct 12.
cases.reply: Understood, Ravi, the migration comes first. Could we trim it to just the monthly churn chart by plan tier, from the existing billing table? If that's doable by Friday 9 October, I'll handle the formatting and the rest of the deck. If even that doesn't fit, is there someone else on your team who knows that table?
cases.note: When a delegated task gets a no, negotiate scope or ask who else, instead of repeating the original ask. If it's still no, flag it to your manager today.

cases.situation: 我手上同时有三个项目：官网改版、双十一活动页、还有领导上周又加给我的供应商系统对接，都说要10月底前完成，我一个人肯定做不完。想让李总定优先级，但不想显得在推活。
cases.reply: 李总，想跟您对一下我手上三个项目的优先级。官网改版、双十一活动页、供应商系统对接目前都排在10月30号前，按我估的工作量，一个人能保证两个按时高质量交付。我的建议是：活动页优先，因为11月1号要开始预热；官网按原计划；供应商对接推到11月中，或者请技术部小王先接前期的接口梳理。您看哪个方案合适？今天能定的话，我明天一早就按新排期推进。
cases.note: 向上求助要带上工作量判断和一个推荐方案，让领导做选择题，而不是把问题整个丢过去。

cases.situation: I'm the new team lead and about 20 years older than most of my team. My report Maya is the Figma expert and I need to be able to edit our prototypes before the Harlow client review on Thursday Oct 8. Asking someone junior to teach me feels strange.
cases.reply: Hi Maya, could you teach me something? I need to make small edits to the onboarding prototype before the Harlow review on Thursday Oct 8, and you know Figma far better than I do. I've done the basics tutorial, so it's mainly components and how the flows link up that I'm stuck on. Could you spare 30 minutes, maybe Thursday or Friday this week? If you're heads-down, a pointer to a good walkthrough would help too.
cases.note: Asking down uses the same shape as asking across: what you've tried, the exact gap, the time cost and an out. Saying she knows it better is context, not flattery.
